Name: AddLemons
Author: Quishi1324
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Mod adds:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8] Lemons that can be grown in garden pots[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8] Lemon jam[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Soda syphon (requires farming lvl 8 to craft)[/color][/*]

[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install all the required mods first![/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the files to the /Stardew Valley/Mods[/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Run the gameusing SMAPI[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Additional mods nedded for proper work:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]SMAPI[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]ContentPatcher[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]CustomBush[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]ProducerFrameworkMod[/color][/*]
[/list]
I`m an absolute beginner at modding, so I`d appreciate any comments, tips or feedback. Hope you enjoy my mod!
